methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Our objective is to clarify these terms and their contributions to energy management.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Conceptual/terminological comparison of an energy information system (EIS) versus an energy management system (EMS) under ISO 50001. Energy performance indicators (EPIs) are mentioned only incidentally as ISO 50001 process elements; the paper presents and characterises no EnPI/EnB measurement model (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). The quantitative component is a count of qualitative comparison elements (12 DIFF, 8 EIS-solicited) yielding 40% complementarity, not an energy performance model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: We used a mixed qualitative and quantitative approach to evaluate and compare the criteria

stage1.notes: Applied context is a French local-authority/community setting (Evreux Porte de Normandie, 74 municipalities), not a continuous process industry. Conceptual EIS-vs-EMS comparison with no energy performance model. paper_type coded 'other' (comparative/conceptual, not model construction); genuinely borderline with 'methodological/theoretical' but no model is constructed.
